main.description: How a public verified listing's app signs users in: its atproto OAuth client metadata URL (client_id) when known, and the scope that metadata publishes. Lets a PDS or client find the permissions an app asks for, e.g. to make a scoped app password, without probing the app's site itself.

uri.description: AT URI of the fyi.atstore.listing.detail record.

authMethod.description: oauth: signs in with atproto OAuth (see clientMetadataUrl). app_password: web sign-in with an app password. unsupported_mobile: native/mobile app only. unknown: not classified yet.

clientMetadataUrl.description: The app's OAuth client metadata URL (its client_id). Fetch it for the authoritative scope.

scope.description: The scope line from the app's client metadata as last probed. May be stale; clientMetadataUrl is authoritative.

checkedAt.description: When this listing's sign-in was last probed.
